ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Corruption in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails and connections between entities involved in Medicaid fraud
questions: What are the financial connections between entities involved in Medicaid fraud?
How much money is involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails and connections between entities, we may uncover a larger scheme and identify key players involved in Medicaid fraud.
